text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, Flash, isn't today... your birthday?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's correct... Was there<n>something you
wanted to talk to me<n>about?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... I was just wondering if<n>you had anyone
to celebrate it with.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, you must've seen me staring at<n>my planner
and gotten worried about<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, you've no need to worry. I<n>was actually
in the middle of making<n>some last-minute
adjustments to my<n>birthday party plans.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You see, Falcon decorated our room,<n>so I want to
make sure we have time<n>to take down those
decorations<n>afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So that's what it was. I'm sorry,<n>you're just
always so serious that<n>I—ah, sorry, I didn't mean
that in a<n>bad way...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...If you'd like, would you care to<n>come eat some of
the cake with us?<n>Think of it as a token of
appreciation<n>for kindly reaching out to me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...! Of course, if you'll have me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Splendid. Let me write your name<n>down in my
planner. Scarlet... and<n>done.
